messages:
Priya: Customer (AcmeMaps) opened a ticket — their per-model throughput panels in Console went to zero around 15:12 UTC after we rolled a metrics change. They say API traffic is normal, but the Console shows flatlined lines for all models. Screenshot attached.

Alex: copying in eng-platform. Do we know if any relabeling or exporter changes went out around that time?

Sam: I deployed a small change to the exporter labels in staging earlier today (rename label `model_id` -> `model_key`) but nothing to prod. @Alex did ops push a config?

Alex: No config push from platform team since 14:50. However, deployment bot shows a redeploy of the metrics-exporter daemonset at 15:05 in cluster-prod-1 (automated node rotation). Could have picked up a new image tag from the CI artifact.

Priya: Customer's ticket includes their timeline: graphs dropped at 15:12, they saw 200 qps to API during that window. They included this query they run in Console: `sum(rate(redwood_model_qps{team="acmemaps"}[1m])) by (model)` — returns zero.

Jin: metrics-bot indicates an alert fired: `console.panel.missing_series` at 15:13 for panels matching `per_model_throughput`. Looking into Prometheus scrape history now.

metrics-bot: promql check: `up{job="exporter"}` -> all 3 exporters up. `count by (model) (redwood_model_qps)` -> 0 series returned. Last samples for `redwood_model_qps` show labelset: `{job="exporter",instance="exp-3"}` (no model label) at 15:05 onwards.

Sam: OK this matches the suspicion: exporter is now emitting `redwood_model_qps` without the model label. In staging my rename emitted `model_key` but I used the wrong upstream mapping for prod (I missed adding `model` alias). My bad.

Alex: Can you hotfix to include the `model` label again? Console panels and dashboards depend on `model` label. We need a short-term fix (re-add label) and a follow-up to make dashboards resilient to label changes (fall back to `model_key`/`model_id`).

Sam: Pushing a 15:40 rollback image with `model` label restored. Will patch exporter to set both labels: `model` and `model_key` so we tolerate both. Deploying now.

Priya: I'll update the customer that we're rolling a fix; advising them their API is unaffected and only Console visualizations were impacted.

metrics-bot: deploy status for daemonset/metrics-exporter: started 15:41, rollout complete 15:46.

Jin: After rollout, Prometheus shows series with `redwood_model_qps{model="gpt-small",team="acmemaps"}` sampled at 15:47. Grafana panels received new series at 15:48.

Priya: Customer confirmed graphs recovered at ~15:50. They asked for root cause and prevention steps. Drafting reply: cause = exporter relabel change removed `model` label; fix = reintroduce `model` and emit stable aliases; prevention = graceful panel queries and a console check that flags zero-series regressions. Thoughts?

Alex: Good. Add a short-term dashboard health check: alert if a panel that normally has >0 series returns 0 series for 3 minutes. Also add a changelog entry and required integration test that ensures `redwood_model_qps` includes at least one of `model`/`model_key` labels on prod exporters.

Sam: I'll open PR for the exporter changes + a postmortem with rollback timeline and config diff.

Priya: Thanks all. I'll close customer ticket after sending the explanation and ETA for the postmortem. :white_check_mark:
